blocks.zh: 本章學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 USP 〈88〉 體內生物反應性試驗的目的、適用範圍及與 〈87〉 的上下游關係
blocks.en: Understand the purpose and scope of USP <88> in vivo biological reactivity tests, and their upstream/downstream relationship with <87>

blocks.en: Master the definitions of the six plastic classes (Class I-VI) and the tests required for each class

blocks.zh: 熟悉四種萃取溶劑（NaCl 注射液、醇-NaCl 液、PEG 400、植物油）的選擇原則
blocks.en: Become familiar with the selection principles for the four extracting media (sodium chloride injection, alcohol in sodium chloride, PEG 400, vegetable oil)

blocks.zh: 理解三種試驗方法：全身注射試驗（Systemic Injection Test）、皮內試驗（Intracutaneous Test）、植入試驗（Implantation Test）的程序差異
blocks.en: Understand how the three test methods differ in procedure: Systemic Injection Test, Intracutaneous Test and Implantation Test

blocks.en: Master the sample surface area rules and the choice of extraction conditions (121°C/70°C/50°C)

blocks.zh: 了解 Draize 皮膚評分系統及植入試驗包膜評分（Encapsulation Scoring）
blocks.en: Understand the Draize skin scoring system and encapsulation scoring for the implantation test

blocks.en: Understand when Safety Tests-Biologicals apply

blocks.zh: 連結 USP 〈88〉 的 CDMO 業務意義：容器系統 Class VI 認證對注射劑包材的監管要求
blocks.en: Link USP <88> to its CDMO business significance: regulatory expectations for Class VI qualification of container systems for injectable packaging materials

blocks.zh: 第一節：總則與定義 Introduction & Definitions
blocks.en: Section 1: Introduction & Definitions

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: 三種試驗的定位：
blocks.en: Positioning of the three tests:

blocks.zh: 全身注射試驗 (Systemic Injection Test): 評估萃取物注射後的全身系統性反應（毒性）→ 使用小鼠
blocks.en: Systemic Injection Test: evaluates the systemic reaction (toxicity) after injection of the extract; mice are used

blocks.zh: 皮內試驗 (Intracutaneous Test): 評估萃取物皮膚注射後的局部反應（刺激性）→ 使用兔子或天竺鼠
blocks.en: Intracutaneous Test: evaluates the local reaction (irritation) after intracutaneous injection of the extract; rabbits or guinea pigs are used

blocks.zh: 植入試驗 (Implantation Test): 評估材料本身直接植入活組織後的組織反應 → 使用兔子（肌肉）或大鼠（皮下）
blocks.en: Implantation Test: evaluates the tissue reaction after the material itself is implanted directly into living tissue; rabbits (muscle) or rats (subcutaneous) are used

blocks.zh: 三個關鍵術語：
blocks.en: Three key terms:

blocks.zh: Sample（樣品）：受試材料本身或其萃取物
blocks.en: Sample: the test material itself or its extract

blocks.zh: Blank（空白）：同量、同處理的萃取溶劑（不含材料）
blocks.en: Blank: the extracting medium alone (no material), in the same amount and treated in the same way

blocks.zh: Negative Control（陰性對照）：在試驗條件下無反應的已知材料
blocks.en: Negative Control: a known material that gives no reaction under the test conditions

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: USP 〈87〉 和 〈88〉 的關係就像是藥品臨床試驗的「細胞試驗 → 動物試驗 → 人體試驗」梯級邏輯。〈87〉 是第一道「體外篩選」；如果細胞試驗過不了，就必須做 〈88〉 的「動物試驗」確認。USP 〈88〉 中的 Blank（空白）就像是對照藥（安慰劑）——你需要比較材料萃取物和純溶劑對動物的影響差距，才能判斷材料本身是否有毒性。
blocks.en: The relationship between USP <87> and <88> is like the stepwise logic of drug development: cell tests, then animal tests, then human trials. <87> is the first, in vitro screen; if the material fails the cell test, the animal tests of <88> must be run to confirm. The Blank in USP <88> is like the control drug (placebo): you compare the effect of the material extract with that of the plain solvent on the animals to decide whether the material itself is toxic.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 使用時機： 〈88〉 的觸發條件有兩種：
blocks.en: When to use: there are two triggers for <88>:

blocks.zh: USP 〈87〉 體外試驗結果 ≥ Grade 3（不合格）→ 必須進行 〈88〉
blocks.en: USP <87> in vitro result of Grade 3 or higher (fail) → <88> must be performed

blocks.zh: 主動申請塑膠分類認證（Class I–VI）→ 需依分類進行 〈88〉
blocks.en: Voluntary application for plastic classification (Class I-VI) → <88> is performed according to the class

blocks.zh: Blank vs. Negative Control 的區別： Blank 是純溶劑（可能因化學成分影響動物）；Negative Control 是已知無毒材料（如 USP HDPE RS）的萃取物，更嚴格。
blocks.en: Blank vs. Negative Control: the Blank is plain solvent (which may still affect the animals through its chemical composition); the Negative Control is the extract of a known non-toxic material (such as USP HDPE RS) and is the more stringent comparator.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 一個新型注射器活塞頭在 USP 〈87〉 的直接接觸試驗中顯示 Grade 3，下一步應怎麼做？
blocks.en: A new syringe plunger tip shows Grade 3 in the USP <87> direct contact test. What should be done next?

blocks.zh: 植入試驗（Implantation Test）無法用萃取物進行，必須植入材料本身——這反映了什麼材料特性的評估需求？
blocks.en: The Implantation Test cannot be done with an extract; the material itself must be implanted. What material property does this reflect a need to evaluate?

blocks.zh: 第二節：塑膠分類 Classification of Plastics (Class I–VI)
blocks.en: Section 2: Classification of Plastics (Class I-VI)

blocks.zh: USP 塑膠分類（Class I–VI）的邏輯：
blocks.en: The logic of the USP plastic classes (Class I-VI):

blocks.zh: 分類越高（Class VI 最嚴格），需要通過的試驗越多、萃取溶劑種類越多。Class VI 必須通過所有四種萃取溶劑的全身注射試驗、皮內試驗，以及植入試驗（兔子 + 大鼠）。
blocks.en: The higher the class (Class VI is the most stringent), the more tests must be passed and the more extracting media are used. Class VI must pass the Systemic Injection Test and Intracutaneous Test with all four extracting media, plus the Implantation Test (rabbit + rat).

blocks.zh: Class VI-121° 的商業意義： 在製藥工業中，「USP Class VI」認證是注射劑包材（如橡膠塞、輸液袋）的業界標準。供應商常以此認證作為材料安全性的商業保證。
blocks.en: Commercial significance of Class VI-121°: in the pharmaceutical industry, "USP Class VI" is the industry standard for injectable packaging materials (such as rubber stoppers and infusion bags). Suppliers often use it as a commercial assurance of material safety.

blocks.zh: 萃取溫度的重要性： 分類標注必須包含萃取溫度。例如 "Class IV-50°" 表示以 50°C 萃取通過 Class IV 測試，比 "Class IV-121°" 的要求嚴苛度低。
blocks.en: Why the extraction temperature matters: the classification must state the extraction temperature. For example, "Class IV-50°" means the material passed the Class IV tests with extraction at 50°C, which is less demanding than "Class IV-121°".

blocks.zh: USP 塑膠分類就像汽車安全碰撞測試的星級評等（1星 → 5星）。Class I 只做最基本測試（相當於1星）；Class VI 要通過所有試驗（相當於5星）。製藥包材通常要求 Class VI，就像醫療設備必須通過最嚴格的安全認證一樣。溫度就像是「測試速度」——121°C 萃取相當於高速碰撞測試，比 50°C（低速）更能揭露材料的潛在安全問題。
blocks.en: The USP plastic classes are like the star ratings of car crash tests (1 star to 5 stars). Class I involves only the most basic tests (the equivalent of 1 star); Class VI must pass all the tests (the equivalent of 5 stars). Pharmaceutical packaging usually requires Class VI, just as medical devices must pass the most stringent safety certification. Temperature is like "test speed": extraction at 121°C is like a high-speed crash test and is better than 50°C (low speed) at exposing potential safety problems in the material.

blocks.zh: 適用限制：
blocks.en: Limits of applicability:

blocks.zh: 分類不適用於口服或外用製劑的容器
blocks.en: The classification does not apply to containers for oral or topical preparations

blocks.zh: 不適用於作為藥物製劑組成成分的塑膠
blocks.en: It does not apply to plastics that are a component of the drug formulation

blocks.zh: 天然橡膠只測 NaCl 和植物油（不做醇和 PEG 萃取）
blocks.en: Natural rubber is tested only with NaCl and vegetable oil (no alcohol or PEG extraction)

blocks.zh: 預處理原則： 材料在終端使用前若需滅菌，試驗樣品必須先經過同樣的滅菌處理。例如，橡膠塞出廠前會進行輻射滅菌，則試驗用橡膠塞也必須先輻射滅菌才進行萃取試驗。
blocks.en: Pretreatment principle: if the material is to be sterilized before final use, the test samples must first undergo the same sterilization. For example, if rubber stoppers are radiation-sterilized before release, the test stoppers must also be radiation-sterilized before extraction testing.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: CDMO 在選擇注射劑容器材料時，供應商 CoA 必須標明 USP Class 和萃取溫度。採購 IV 袋材料時，標準規格通常要求至少 Class VI-121°。在客戶技術協議（Quality Technical Agreement）中，也必須明確列明包材的 USP 塑膠分類要求，並保留供應商提供的原始試驗報告作為批次記錄的一部分。
blocks.en: When a CDMO selects container materials for injectables, the supplier CoA must state the USP Class and the extraction temperature. For IV bag materials, the standard specification usually requires at least Class VI-121°. The Quality Technical Agreement with the client must also state the USP plastic class requirement for the packaging material explicitly, and the original test report supplied by the supplier must be retained as part of the batch record.

blocks.zh: 第三節：萃取溶劑 Extracting Media
blocks.en: Section 3: Extracting Media

blocks.zh: 四種萃取溶劑的設計邏輯：
blocks.en: Design logic of the four extracting media:

blocks.zh: 0.9% NaCl（生理鹽水）： 模擬水性注射製劑接觸環境（最常見）
blocks.en: 0.9% NaCl (physiological saline): simulates the contact environment of aqueous injectable products (the most common)

blocks.zh: 1:20 酒精/NaCl： 模擬含醇溶劑製劑（某些注射劑輔料）
blocks.en: 1:20 alcohol/NaCl: simulates alcohol-containing solvent systems (some injectable excipients)

blocks.zh: Polyethylene Glycol 400： 模擬半固體/油性製劑溶劑
blocks.en: Polyethylene Glycol 400: simulates the solvents of semi-solid/oily preparations

blocks.zh: 植物油（芝麻油/棉籽油）： 模擬油性注射製劑（如某些維生素注射液）
blocks.en: Vegetable oil (sesame oil/cottonseed oil): simulates oily injectable preparations (such as some vitamin injections)

blocks.zh: 選擇邏輯：萃取溶劑應盡量模擬實際藥品接觸的溶劑性質。高極性藥品 → NaCl；含醇製劑 → 醇-NaCl；油性製劑 → 植物油。
blocks.en: Selection logic: the extracting medium should simulate, as closely as possible, the solvent properties of the drug the material actually contacts. Highly polar drugs → NaCl; alcohol-containing preparations → alcohol-NaCl; oily preparations → vegetable oil.

blocks.zh: Draize 皮膚評分系統 Draize Scoring System
blocks.en: Draize Scoring System

blocks.zh: Draize 評分法（1944年由 Draize, Woodward, Calvery 建立）是評估皮內試驗局部反應的標準方法，分別評估：
blocks.en: The Draize scoring method (established in 1944 by Draize, Woodward and Calvery) is the standard method for evaluating the local reaction in the intracutaneous test. It scores two items separately:

blocks.zh: 紅斑/焦痂形成（Erythema/Eschar）： 0–4 分
blocks.en: Erythema/Eschar formation: 0-4 points

blocks.zh: 水腫形成（Edema）： 0–4 分
blocks.en: Edema formation: 0-4 points

blocks.zh: 最終計算樣品與空白的平均分數差值，差值 ≤ 1.0 為合格。
blocks.en: Finally, the difference between the mean scores of the Sample and the Blank is calculated; a difference of ≤ 1.0 passes.

blocks.zh: 選擇萃取溶劑就像「模擬真實使用環境」的概念。你的橡膠塞最終會接觸到生理鹽水，所以就用生理鹽水來萃取測試；如果你的藥品含有酒精輔料，就用酒精-NaCl 來萃取。這是一種「最壞情況模擬」的策略：萃取溶劑應代表實際使用中最可能溶出毒性物質的溶劑環境。
blocks.en: Choosing the extracting medium is about "simulating the real use environment". Your rubber stopper will ultimately contact physiological saline, so saline is used for the extraction test; if your drug contains alcohol as an excipient, alcohol-NaCl is used. This is a "worst-case simulation" strategy: the extracting medium should represent the solvent environment most likely to leach toxic substances in actual use.

blocks.zh: 植物油品質確認的特殊要求： 植物油本身必須先通過皮內試驗（皮膚刺激性）才能用作萃取溶劑。評分標準：紅斑平均 ≤ 0.5，水腫平均 ≤ 1.0，任何注射部位腫塊直徑 ≤ 10 mm。
blocks.en: Special requirement for qualifying vegetable oil: the vegetable oil itself must first pass the intracutaneous test (skin irritation) before it can be used as an extracting medium. Scoring criteria: mean erythema ≤ 0.5, mean edema ≤ 1.0, and any lump at an injection site ≤ 10 mm in diameter.

blocks.zh: 區分水腫 vs. 油脂殘留： 注射油性製劑後注射部位可能殘留油脂，外觀類似水腫，但按壓後腫脹不消退（真水腫）vs. 油脂殘留按壓後消退。Draize 方法明確指出：「水腫組織在輕輕按壓時會變白（blanches）」。
blocks.en: Distinguishing edema from oil residue: after an oily preparation is injected, oil may remain at the injection site and look like edema. True edema does not subside when pressed, whereas oil residue does. The Draize method states explicitly: "edematous tissue blanches when gently pressed".

blocks.zh: 一個用於儲存維生素 E 注射液（油性製劑）的 PVC 輸液袋，應使用哪種萃取溶劑？
blocks.en: Which extracting medium should be used for a PVC infusion bag that stores vitamin E injection (an oily preparation)?

blocks.zh: 如果新批次芝麻油的皮內試驗顯示某注射部位水腫評分為 2，平均水腫評分為 1.2，是否符合要求？
blocks.en: If the intracutaneous test of a new lot of sesame oil shows an edema score of 2 at one injection site and a mean edema score of 1.2, does it meet the requirement?

blocks.zh: Draize 評分中，「紅斑評分 3」代表什麼程度的皮膚反應？
blocks.en: In Draize scoring, what degree of skin reaction does an "erythema score of 3" represent?

blocks.zh: 第四節：儀器設備與樣品製備 Apparatus & Sample Preparation
blocks.en: Section 4: Apparatus & Sample Preparation

blocks.zh: Table 3 樣品表面積規則（關鍵記憶點）：
blocks.en: Table 3 sample surface area rules (key points to remember):

blocks.zh: 薄膜/片材 <0.5 mm → 120 cm² / 20 mL
blocks.en: Film/sheet <0.5 mm → 120 cm² / 20 mL

blocks.zh: 薄膜/片材 0.5–1 mm → 60 cm² / 20 mL
blocks.en: Film/sheet 0.5-1 mm → 60 cm² / 20 mL

blocks.zh: 管件：依 ID/OD 周長計算長度
blocks.en: Tubing: calculate the length from the ID/OD circumference

blocks.zh: 厚片、管件、成型件 >1 mm → 60 cm² / 20 mL
blocks.en: Thick slabs, tubing and molded items >1 mm → 60 cm² / 20 mL

blocks.zh: 彈性體 >1 mm → 25 cm² / 20 mL（不切割，整體測試）
blocks.en: Elastomers >1 mm → 25 cm² / 20 mL (not cut; tested whole)

blocks.zh: 萃取時間-溫度關係（三種標準條件）：
blocks.en: Extraction time-temperature relationship (three standard conditions):

blocks.zh: 121°C / 60 min（高壓蒸汽滅菌條件）
blocks.en: 121°C / 60 min (autoclave conditions)

blocks.zh: 70°C / 24 h（高溫烤箱）
blocks.en: 70°C / 24 h (high-temperature oven)

blocks.zh: 50°C / 72 h（中溫烤箱）
blocks.en: 50°C / 72 h (medium-temperature oven)

blocks.zh: 公式與計算 Surface Area Formulas
blocks.en: Surface Area Formulas

blocks.zh:
薄膜/片材 雙面表面積計算：
  面積 = 長 × 寬 × 2（正反兩面）

管件長度計算（<0.5 mm 壁厚）：
  L (cm) = 120 cm² / (π×ID + π×OD)

管件長度計算（0.5–1 mm 壁厚）：
  L (cm) = 60 cm² / (π×ID + π×OD)

萃取比例（無法測面積時）：
  彈性體：0.1 g / 1 mL 萃取液
  塑膠/其他高分子：0.2 g / 1 mL 萃取液
blocks.en:
Film/sheet, both-sides surface area:
  Area = length × width × 2 (front and back)

Tubing length (wall thickness <0.5 mm):
  L (cm) = 120 cm² / (π×ID + π×OD)

Tubing length (wall thickness 0.5-1 mm):
  L (cm) = 60 cm² / (π×ID + π×OD)

Extraction ratio (when the area cannot be measured):
  Elastomers: 0.1 g / 1 mL extracting medium
  Plastics/other polymers: 0.2 g / 1 mL extracting medium

blocks.zh: Table 3 的表面積規則就像「泡茶的茶葉量規定」。茶葉越薄（薄膜 <0.5 mm），萃出物越多，所以需要更多茶葉（120 cm²）才能測到代表性水平；茶葉越厚（塊狀 >1 mm），萃出較慢，反而用較少量（60 cm²）。彈性體是特例——整個不切，因為切割面會暴露內部成分，不能代表實際使用時的真實萃出狀況。
blocks.en: The Table 3 surface area rules are like "rules for the amount of tea leaves when brewing tea". The thinner the leaves (film <0.5 mm), the more is extracted, so more leaves (120 cm²) are needed to reach a representative level; the thicker the leaves (chunks >1 mm), the slower the extraction, so a smaller amount (60 cm²) is used. Elastomers are the special case: they are not cut at all, because cut surfaces would expose internal components and would not represent the real extraction that occurs in actual use.

blocks.zh: 樣品清洗的禁忌：
blocks.en: Prohibitions when cleaning samples:

blocks.zh: 禁止用乾布或濕布擦拭
blocks.en: Do not wipe with a dry or wet cloth

blocks.zh: 禁止用有機溶劑沖洗
blocks.en: Do not rinse with organic solvents

blocks.zh: 禁止用表面活性劑清洗
blocks.en: Do not wash with surfactants

blocks.zh: 只能用 Water for Injection 搖動清洗
blocks.en: Clean only by shaking in Water for Injection

blocks.zh: 原因：任何殘留的清潔劑都可能進入萃取液，干擾試驗結果（假陽性）。
blocks.en: Reason: any residual cleaning agent could enter the extract and interfere with the test result (false positive).

blocks.zh: 萃取液保存與使用期限： 萃取完成後 24 h 內必須使用，儲存溫度 20°–30°C（室溫）。超時棄置，重新萃取。
blocks.en: Storage and use period of the extract: the extract must be used within 24 h after extraction, stored at 20°-30°C (room temperature). If this time is exceeded, discard it and re-extract.

blocks.zh: 萃取條件的物理限制： 萃取溫度和時間不得造成樣品物理變化（融化、熔合）——這會減少可用表面積，導致試驗數據失真。
blocks.en: Physical limits of the extraction conditions: the extraction temperature and time must not cause physical changes in the sample (melting, fusing), because this reduces the available surface area and distorts the test data.

blocks.zh: 第五節：全身注射試驗 Systemic Injection Test
blocks.en: Section 5: Systemic Injection Test

blocks.zh: 注射途徑（Routes of Injection）：
blocks.en: Routes of Injection:

blocks.zh: IV（靜脈注射，intravenous）： 水性萃取液（NaCl, 醇-NaCl, 藥品溶媒）→ 模擬靜脈注射製劑的暴露途徑
blocks.en: IV (intravenous): aqueous extracts (NaCl, alcohol-NaCl, drug vehicle) → simulates the exposure route of intravenous products

blocks.zh: IP（腹腔注射，intraperitoneal）： 油性/油溶性萃取液（PEG 400, 植物油）→ 模擬不可靜脈注射之溶劑
blocks.en: IP (intraperitoneal): oily/oil-soluble extracts (PEG 400, vegetable oil) → simulates solvents that cannot be given intravenously

blocks.zh: 試驗動物規格：
blocks.en: Test animal specifications:

blocks.zh: 品系：白化小鼠（albino mice）
blocks.en: Strain: albino mice
Body weight: 17-23 g

blocks.zh: 每組：5 隻（必要時重複，10 隻）
blocks.en: Per group: 5 animals (repeated with 10 if necessary)

blocks.zh: 之前未使用過的（naïve animals）
blocks.en: Previously unused (naïve animals)

blocks.zh: 公式與計算 Pass/Fail Criteria
blocks.en: Pass/Fail Criteria

blocks.zh:
合格（Pass）：Sample 組無顯著大於 Blank 組的反應

不合格（Fail）：下列任一條件：
  - ≥2 隻小鼠死亡
  - ≥2 隻小鼠出現異常行為（抽搐/昏迷）
  - ≥3 隻小鼠體重下降 >2 g

邊緣情況（Borderline）→ 重複試驗（10隻）：
  - ≤1 隻出現明顯症狀或死亡
  重複試驗時，全部 10 隻均需無顯著反應

觀察時間點：
  注射後立即、4h、24h、48h、72h
blocks.en:
Pass: the Sample group shows no significantly greater reaction than the Blank group

Fail: any of the following conditions:
  - ≥2 mice die
  - ≥2 mice show abnormal behavior (convulsions/prostration)
  - ≥3 mice lose more than 2 g of body weight

Borderline → repeat the test (10 animals):
  - ≤1 animal shows marked symptoms or dies
  In the repeat test, all 10 animals must show no significant reaction

Observation time points:
  Immediately after injection, 4 h, 24 h, 48 h, 72 h

blocks.zh: 全身注射試驗就像是「安全試驗的最後防線」。把材料萃取液直接注射進小鼠體內，觀察牠們接下來 72 小時的反應。這就像是一個超快速的毒理學篩選——如果材料真的溶出了毒性物質，小鼠會在幾小時到幾天內出現症狀（抽搐、死亡、體重劇降）。注射前搖勻萃取液是為了確保毒性物質均勻分佈，就像搖勻藥水後再倒出等量。
blocks.en: The Systemic Injection Test is the "last line of defense" of safety testing. The material extract is injected directly into mice and their reactions are observed over the next 72 hours. It is an extremely rapid toxicology screen: if the material really leaches toxic substances, the mice show symptoms (convulsions, death, sharp weight loss) within hours to days. The extract is shaken before injection to ensure that any toxic substances are evenly distributed, just as you shake a liquid medicine before pouring out an equal dose.

blocks.zh: PEG 400 稀釋的原因： PEG 400 純液直接靜脈注射會因滲透壓過高傷害動物，必須用 NaCl 稀釋至約 200 mg/mL（1g PEG : 4.1 體積 NaCl）才能 IP 注射。
blocks.en: Why PEG 400 is diluted: undiluted PEG 400 injected intravenously would injure the animals because of its excessive osmotic pressure, so it must be diluted with NaCl to about 200 mg/mL (1 g PEG : 4.1 volumes of NaCl) before IP injection.

blocks.zh: 邊緣情況處理邏輯： 若有 1 隻（而非 2 隻以上）出現問題 → 不直接判定不合格，改用 10 隻重複試驗。這體現了統計學思維——5 隻中 1 隻可能是個體差異，10 隻中 0 隻才有更高的信心。
blocks.en: Logic for handling the borderline case: if one animal (rather than two or more) shows a problem, the test is not failed outright but repeated with 10 animals. This reflects statistical thinking: one in 5 may be individual variation, but 0 in 10 gives much higher confidence.

blocks.zh: CDMO 在執行全身注射試驗時，必須確保動物設施（Animal Facility）具備 IACUC（機構動物照護及使用委員會）核准，並遵循 3R 原則（Reduction, Replacement, Refinement）。試驗記錄必須包含每隻動物的 ID、體重記錄、行為觀察評估，並由獸醫或授權人員簽署。這些記錄將成為藥品申請文件的一部分。
blocks.en: When performing the Systemic Injection Test, a CDMO must ensure that the animal facility has IACUC (Institutional Animal Care and Use Committee) approval and follows the 3R principles (Reduction, Replacement, Refinement). Test records must include each animal's ID, body weight records and behavioral observation assessments, and be signed by a veterinarian or authorized person. These records become part of the regulatory submission.

blocks.zh: 第六節：皮內試驗 Intracutaneous Test
blocks.en: Section 6: Intracutaneous Test

blocks.zh: 試驗設計的巧妙之處：
blocks.en: The clever design of the test:

blocks.zh: 同一隻動物的脊椎左右兩側分別注射 Sample 和 Blank：
blocks.en: The Sample and the Blank are injected on the left and right sides of the spine of the same animal:

blocks.zh: 左側（或右側）：5 個 Sample 注射點
blocks.en: Left side (or right side): 5 Sample injection sites

blocks.zh: 右側（或左側）：5 個 Blank 注射點
blocks.en: Right side (or left side): 5 Blank injection sites

blocks.zh: 同一隻動物作為自身對照，大幅減少個體差異的影響。這是精心設計的「配對試驗」（paired test）。
blocks.en: The same animal serves as its own control, which greatly reduces the effect of individual variation. This is a carefully designed "paired test".

blocks.zh: 評分計算方式：
blocks.en: How the score is calculated:

blocks.zh: 評分次數：3 個時間點（24h, 48h, 72h）
blocks.en: Number of scoring times: 3 time points (24 h, 48 h, 72 h)

blocks.zh: 評分類別：2 類（紅斑 + 水腫）
blocks.en: Scoring categories: 2 (erythema + edema)

blocks.zh: 動物數：2 隻
blocks.en: Number of animals: 2

blocks.zh: 分母 = 2 × 3 × 2 = 12
blocks.en: Denominator = 2 × 3 × 2 = 12

blocks.zh: 公式與計算 Scoring Formula
blocks.en: Scoring Formula

blocks.zh:
整體平均分數計算：
  總分 = Σ(紅斑分數) + Σ(水腫分數)
       （所有動物、所有時間點、所有注射點）

  平均分數 = 總分 / 12
  （12 = 2隻動物 × 3時間點 × 2評分類別）

合格標準：
  |Sample 平均分 - Blank 平均分| ≤ 1.0

例：Sample 平均 = 1.2，Blank 平均 = 0.3
    差值 = 0.9 → 合格 ✓

例：Sample 平均 = 2.5，Blank 平均 = 0.8
    差值 = 1.7 → 不合格 ✗
blocks.en:
Overall mean score calculation:
  Total score = Σ(erythema scores) + Σ(edema scores)
       (all animals, all time points, all injection sites)

  Mean score = total score / 12
  (12 = 2 animals × 3 time points × 2 scoring categories)

Acceptance criterion:
  |Sample mean score - Blank mean score| ≤ 1.0

Example: Sample mean = 1.2, Blank mean = 0.3
    Difference = 0.9 → Pass ✓

Example: Sample mean = 2.5, Blank mean = 0.8
    Difference = 1.7 → Fail ✗

blocks.zh: 皮內試驗就像是「皮膚過敏測試」（常見的過敏原點刺試驗）的動物版本。你把萃取液注射進皮膚，72 小時內觀察是否出現紅腫。同一隻兔子的左右兩側同時做試驗和對照，就像是你左手注射可疑物質、右手注射生理鹽水，然後比較哪側反應更大——控制了個體皮膚敏感度的差異。
blocks.en: The intracutaneous test is the animal version of a "skin allergy test" (the common allergen skin prick test). The extract is injected into the skin, and over 72 hours you watch for redness and swelling. Testing and controlling on the left and right sides of the same rabbit at the same time is like injecting a suspect substance in your left arm and physiological saline in your right arm, then comparing which side reacts more, which controls for differences in individual skin sensitivity.

blocks.zh: 分毛注意事項： 必須用真空吸塵方式清除散落毛髮（不能用手），避免毛髮殘留在注射部位造成機械刺激，干擾結果判讀。
blocks.en: Precautions when removing hair: loose hair must be removed by vacuum (not by hand), to prevent hair left at the injection site from causing mechanical irritation that interferes with reading the results.

blocks.zh: PEG 400 皮內試驗的稀釋（不同於全身注射）： 皮內注射 PEG 400：稀釋至 120 mg/mL（1g + 7.4 倍 NaCl），比全身注射（200 mg/mL）更稀。因為皮內組織比腹腔更敏感，需要更低的濃度以避免高滲透壓造成非特異性刺激。
blocks.en: Dilution of PEG 400 for the intracutaneous test (different from systemic injection): for intracutaneous injection, PEG 400 is diluted to 120 mg/mL (1 g + 7.4 volumes of NaCl), which is more dilute than for systemic injection (200 mg/mL). Intracutaneous tissue is more sensitive than the peritoneal cavity, so a lower concentration is needed to avoid non-specific irritation caused by high osmotic pressure.

blocks.zh: 差值 vs. 絕對值： 合格標準是 Sample 與 Blank 的「差值」≤1.0，而非絕對分數。即使 Sample 分數較高，只要不超過 Blank 太多，仍可合格。
blocks.en: Difference vs. absolute value: the acceptance criterion is the "difference" between Sample and Blank of ≤1.0, not an absolute score. Even if the Sample score is higher, it can still pass as long as it does not exceed the Blank by too much.

blocks.zh: 第七節：植入試驗 Implantation Test
blocks.en: Section 7: Implantation Test

blocks.zh: 植入試驗就像是「身體對外來物的排斥測試」。你把材料條直接縫進動物的肌肉或皮下，然後等待觀察身體的免疫反應——身體會在異物周圍形成一層「包膜」（膠原蛋白纖維包覆）。包膜越厚，代表免疫反應越強、材料相容性越差。USP HDPE（高密度聚乙烯）是已知的低反應材料，作為「背景值」對照——你的材料不能比 HDPE 引起更強的組織反應（差值 ≤1.0）。
blocks.en: The Implantation Test is like a "rejection test of the body against a foreign object". Strips of the material are implanted directly into the muscle or under the skin of the animal, and then the immune reaction of the body is observed. The body forms a "capsule" (a wrapping of collagen fibers) around the foreign body. The thicker the capsule, the stronger the immune reaction and the poorer the material compatibility. USP HDPE (high-density polyethylene) is a known low-reactivity material and serves as the "background" control: your material must not cause a stronger tissue reaction than HDPE (difference ≤1.0).

blocks.zh: 植入試驗設計摘要 Implantation Test Summary
blocks.en: Implantation Test Summary

blocks.zh:
兔子肌肉植入（Intramuscular）：
  每隻兔：脊椎一側植入 4 條 Sample
         對側植入 2 條 HDPE Control
  共 2 隻兔 → 8 條 Sample, 4 條 Control
  觀察期：NLT 120 h（≥5天）

大鼠皮下植入（Subcutaneous）：
  每隻大鼠：2條 Sample + 2條 Control
  共 5 隻大鼠 → 10 Sample, 10 Control
  觀察期：≥7 天

判定：|Sample 平均分 - Control 平均分| ≤ 1.0
blocks.en:
Rabbit intramuscular implantation:
  Each rabbit: 4 Sample strips implanted on one side of the spine
         2 HDPE Control strips implanted on the opposite side
  2 rabbits in total → 8 Sample strips, 4 Control strips
  Observation period: NLT 120 h (≥5 days)

Rat subcutaneous implantation:
  Each rat: 2 Sample + 2 Control
  5 rats in total → 10 Sample, 10 Control
  Observation period: ≥7 days

Determination: |Sample mean score - Control mean score| ≤ 1.0

blocks.zh: 邊緣光滑的重要性： 植入條的邊緣必須盡量光滑，以避免機械創傷引起的非特異性組織反應，干擾評估材料本身的生物相容性。
blocks.en: Importance of smooth edges: the edges of the implant strips must be as smooth as possible, to avoid non-specific tissue reactions caused by mechanical trauma, which would interfere with evaluating the biocompatibility of the material itself.

blocks.zh: 皮下大鼠模型的優勢： 當材料物理特性不適合切成肌肉植入條狀（如柔軟薄膜），可改用大鼠皮下模型，制備成圓片狀植入。
blocks.en: Advantage of the rat subcutaneous model: when the physical properties of the material are not suitable for cutting into strips for intramuscular implantation (such as soft film), the rat subcutaneous model can be used instead, with the material prepared as discs for implantation.

blocks.zh: 大體檢查要點： 出血（hemorrhage）、壞死（necrosis）、變色（discoloration）、感染（infection）都需記錄，不僅限於包膜測量。
blocks.en: Key points of the gross examination: hemorrhage, necrosis, discoloration and infection must all be recorded, not only the capsule measurement.

blocks.zh: 心臟瓣膜、骨科植入物、縫合線等醫療器材必須通過植入試驗（通常還需進行更長期的 ISO 10993-6 植入試驗：4週、12週甚至更長）。USP 〈88〉 的 7–5 天植入試驗是短期評估，是後續長期試驗設計的基礎。CDMO 在開發可植入器材的藥物遞送系統（如緩釋植入劑）時，必須規劃完整的生物相容性測試序列。
blocks.en: Medical devices such as heart valves, orthopedic implants and sutures must pass implantation testing (usually with the longer-term ISO 10993-6 implantation tests of 4 weeks, 12 weeks or even longer as well). The 5-7 day implantation test of USP <88> is a short-term evaluation and the basis for designing later long-term tests. When a CDMO develops drug delivery systems for implantable devices (such as sustained-release implants), a complete biocompatibility testing sequence must be planned.

blocks.zh: 植入試驗的獨特性：
blocks.en: What is unique about the Implantation Test:

blocks.zh: 唯一直接植入材料本身（非萃取物）的試驗
blocks.en: The only test in which the material itself (not an extract) is implanted directly

blocks.zh: 評估的是「長期組織相容性」而非急性毒性
blocks.en: Evaluates "long-term tissue compatibility" rather than acute toxicity

blocks.zh: 終點指標：包膜形成（Encapsulation）——組織對異物的反應程度
blocks.en: Endpoint: Encapsulation, the degree of tissue reaction to the foreign body

blocks.zh: 第八節：安全試驗——生物製品 Safety Tests — Biologicals
blocks.en: Section 8: Safety Tests - Biologicals

blocks.zh: 安全試驗—生物製品的特殊地位：
blocks.en: The special status of Safety Tests-Biologicals:

blocks.zh: 這個試驗不是針對包材材料（如前幾節），而是針對生物製品本身（如疫苗、單抗、血液製品）進行的安全篩選。目的是偵測批次中任何意外的、不可接受的生物反應性——例如批次污染、非預期毒性物質。
blocks.en: This test is not aimed at packaging materials (as in the preceding sections) but at the biological product itself (such as vaccines, monoclonal antibodies and blood products), as a safety screen. Its purpose is to detect any unexpected, unacceptable biological reactivity in a lot, for example lot contamination or unanticipated toxic substances.

blocks.zh: 與前幾節試驗的關鍵差異：
blocks.en: Key differences from the tests in the preceding sections:

blocks.zh: 受試物：生物製品（不是包材萃取物）
blocks.en: Test article: the biological product (not an extract of packaging material)

blocks.zh: 注射量：固定 0.5 mL（不按體重調整）
blocks.en: Injection volume: fixed at 0.5 mL (not adjusted by body weight)

blocks.zh: 觀察期：48 h（比全身注射試驗的 72 h 短）
blocks.en: Observation period: 48 h (shorter than the 72 h of the Systemic Injection Test)

blocks.zh: 針頭：26-gauge（較細，適合小鼠）
blocks.en: Needle: 26-gauge (finer, suited to mice)

blocks.zh: 安全試驗就像是每批疫苗出廠前的「試打確認」——你先給小鼠注射，確認沒有預期外的毒性，才能允許放行給人類使用。這不是測試疫苗是否有效，而是確認批次製品沒有意外的有害物質（如殘留毒素、工藝污染物）。CFR 610.11 的引用代表此試驗與美國 FDA 生物製品批准直接掛鉤。
blocks.en: The safety test is like a "trial shot" before each vaccine lot is released: you first inject mice to confirm there is no unexpected toxicity before release for human use is allowed. It does not test whether the vaccine is effective; it confirms that the lot contains no unexpected harmful substances (such as residual toxins or process contaminants). The reference to 21 CFR 610.11 shows that this test is directly tied to FDA approval of biological products in the United States.

blocks.zh: 組織病理學（Histopathology）的觸發條件： 當動物出現毒性症狀時，需進行大體解剖（gross necropsy），必要時進行組織病理學檢查（histopathology）。這為毒性機制的科學調查提供了依據。
blocks.en: Trigger for histopathology: when animals show signs of toxicity, a gross necropsy is required and, where necessary, histopathology. This provides a basis for scientific investigation of the mechanism of toxicity.

blocks.zh: 體重監測的重要性： 試驗前和試驗後都需記錄體重。體重變化是全身毒性的敏感指標，比行為觀察更早出現。
blocks.en: Importance of body weight monitoring: body weight must be recorded before and after the test. Weight change is a sensitive indicator of systemic toxicity and appears earlier than behavioral observation.

blocks.zh: CFR 610.11 的意義： 美國 Code of Federal Regulations（聯邦法規彙編）第 610.11 條款規定了生物製品批次放行的安全試驗要求。對於生物藥（biologic），USP 〈88〉 的安全試驗和 FDA CFR 要求是互相銜接的。
blocks.en: Significance of CFR 610.11: Section 610.11 of the US Code of Federal Regulations sets out the general safety test requirements for lot release of biological products. For biologics, the USP <88> safety test and the FDA CFR requirements are closely linked.

blocks.zh: CDMO 承接抗體藥物（mAb）或疫苗的代工生產時，每批次放行必須包含安全試驗數據（5隻小鼠，48h 觀察，全存活）。此試驗通常由具備 GLP（Good Laboratory Practice）認可的動物試驗機構執行，出具正式的試驗報告。試驗失敗必須啟動偏差調查（Deviation Investigation），並通知監管機構（如 FDA）。
blocks.en: When a CDMO manufactures monoclonal antibody (mAb) drugs or vaccines under contract, the release of each lot must include safety test data (5 mice, 48 h observation, all surviving). This test is usually performed by an animal testing facility with GLP (Good Laboratory Practice) recognition, which issues a formal test report. A failed test must trigger a deviation investigation and notification of the regulatory authority (such as the FDA).

blocks.zh: 安全試驗—生物製品中，如果 5 隻小鼠中有 1 隻出現輕度症狀但存活，試驗是否合格？應採取什麼後續行動？
blocks.en: In the Safety Tests-Biologicals, if 1 of 5 mice shows mild symptoms but survives, does the test pass? What follow-up action should be taken?

blocks.zh: 全身注射試驗（包材）和安全試驗（生物製品）都使用小鼠，但注射量不同——前者 50 mL/kg，後者 0.5 mL 固定量。為什麼有這個差異？
blocks.en: The Systemic Injection Test (packaging materials) and the Safety Test (biologicals) both use mice, but the injection volumes differ: 50 mL/kg for the former and a fixed 0.5 mL for the latter. Why is there this difference?

blocks.zh: 某批次單抗在安全試驗中有 2 隻小鼠死亡，下一步最合適的應對方案是什麼？
blocks.en: In a mAb lot, 2 mice die in the Safety Test. What is the most appropriate next step?

blocks.zh: 第九節：USP 〈88〉 三種試驗綜合比較 Three In Vivo Tests Comparison
blocks.en: Section 9: Comparison of the Three USP <88> In Vivo Tests

blocks.zh: 三種試驗整合比較表
blocks.en: Integrated comparison table of the three tests

blocks.zh: 三種試驗的互補性
blocks.en: How the three tests complement each other

blocks.zh: 三種試驗分別評估不同的毒理學終點：
blocks.en: The three tests evaluate different toxicological endpoints:

blocks.zh: 全身注射試驗：萃取物的急性全身毒性（短期、全身）
blocks.en: Systemic Injection Test: acute systemic toxicity of the extract (short term, whole body)

blocks.zh: 皮內試驗：萃取物的局部刺激性（短期、局部）
blocks.en: Intracutaneous Test: local irritation by the extract (short term, local)

blocks.zh: 植入試驗：材料的慢性組織反應（較長期、直接接觸）
blocks.en: Implantation Test: chronic tissue reaction to the material (longer term, direct contact)

blocks.zh: 三種試驗的結合，提供了材料安全性的多維度評估，覆蓋不同的暴露途徑和時間尺度。
blocks.en: Combined, the three tests give a multi-dimensional evaluation of material safety, covering different exposure routes and time scales.

blocks.zh: USP 〈87〉 vs. 〈88〉 完整關係圖：
blocks.en: Complete relationship between USP <87> and <88>:

blocks.zh: 〈87〉（體外）→ Grade ≤ 2 → 材料合格，無需 〈88〉
blocks.en: <87> (in vitro) → Grade ≤ 2 → material passes; <88> not needed

blocks.zh: 〈87〉（體外）→ Grade ≥ 3 → 需進行 〈88〉（體內）
blocks.en: <87> (in vitro) → Grade ≥ 3 → <88> (in vivo) required

blocks.zh: 〈88〉 主動申請分類（Class I–VI）→ 獨立於 〈87〉 結果
blocks.en: <88> voluntary classification (Class I-VI) → independent of the <87> result

blocks.zh: 〈88〉 安全試驗—生物製品 → 適用於生物藥批次放行
blocks.en: <88> Safety Tests-Biologicals → applies to lot release of biologics

blocks.zh: 本章重點回顧 Chapter Summary
blocks.en: Chapter Summary

blocks.zh: 目的： USP 〈88〉 以動物試驗評估彈性體和塑膠材料的體內生物反應性，是 USP 〈87〉 的後續試驗
blocks.en: Purpose: USP <88> uses animal tests to evaluate the in vivo biological reactivity of elastomeric and plastic materials, and follows on from USP <87>

blocks.zh: 塑膠分類： Class I–VI，嚴苛度遞增；必須標注萃取溫度（如 Class VI-121°）
blocks.en: Plastic classes: Class I-VI, increasing in stringency; the extraction temperature must be stated (e.g., Class VI-121°)

blocks.zh: 萃取溶劑： 四種（NaCl、醇-NaCl、PEG 400、植物油）；應代表實際接觸的製劑溶劑環境
blocks.en: Extracting media: four (NaCl, alcohol-NaCl, PEG 400, vegetable oil); they should represent the solvent environment of the drug actually contacted

blocks.zh: 三種試驗： 全身注射試驗（小鼠，72h，全身毒性）、皮內試驗（兔子/天竺鼠，72h，局部刺激）、植入試驗（兔子肌肉/大鼠皮下，5–7天，組織相容性）
blocks.en: Three tests: Systemic Injection Test (mouse, 72 h, systemic toxicity), Intracutaneous Test (rabbit/guinea pig, 72 h, local irritation), Implantation Test (rabbit muscle/rat subcutaneous, 5-7 days, tissue compatibility)

blocks.zh: 樣品表面積： 依材料形狀和厚度計算；彈性體 25 cm²/20 mL，薄片 60–120 cm²/20 mL
blocks.en: Sample surface area: calculated by material shape and thickness; elastomers 25 cm²/20 mL, thin sheets 60-120 cm²/20 mL

blocks.zh: 萃取條件： 121°C/60 min、70°C/24h、50°C/72h；萃取後 24h 內使用
blocks.en: Extraction conditions: 121°C/60 min, 70°C/24 h, 50°C/72 h; use within 24 h after extraction

blocks.zh: 皮膚評分： Draize 量表（0–4），Sample vs. Blank 差值 ≤ 1.0 合格
blocks.en: Skin scoring: Draize scale (0-4); a Sample vs. Blank difference of ≤ 1.0 passes

blocks.zh: 包膜評分： 植入試驗 0–4 分（None → >2mm）；差值 ≤ 1.0 合格
blocks.en: Encapsulation scoring: implantation test 0-4 points (None → >2 mm); a difference of ≤ 1.0 passes

blocks.zh: 安全試驗—生物製品： 5 隻小鼠，0.5 mL，48h；生物藥批次放行用
blocks.en: Safety Tests-Biologicals: 5 mice, 0.5 mL, 48 h; used for lot release of biologics

blocks.zh: CDMO 業務意義： Class VI 認證是注射劑包材選擇的行業標準；試驗數據支持 IND/NDA/MAA 申請的 Container Closure System 章節
blocks.en: CDMO business significance: Class VI qualification is the industry standard for selecting injectable packaging materials; test data support the Container Closure System section of IND/NDA/MAA submissions

blocks.en: SterileGMP Knowledge Hub | Sterile Pharmaceutical GMP Knowledge Base
